definitions.gloss: to argue down; to out-talk; to defeat in argument
definitions.explanation: To win an argument by talking; to silence someone through superior argumentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{負|ま}かされて⟦{凹|へこ}んだ→凹む：00097_hekomu⟧。
examples.english: I was talked down by him and felt deflated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{負|ま}かした。
examples.english: I out-argued my opponent in the debate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{言|い}い{負|ま}かされない。
examples.english: She can't be out-talked by anyone.

notes:
{言|い}い{負|ま}かす means to defeat someone in an argument.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{負|ま}かす (out-talk X)

FORMS:
⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + {負|ま}かす (to defeat) = defeat by saying

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {言|い}い{負|ま}かされる: to be out-argued (passive)
- {言|い}い{負|ま}かせない: cannot out-argue
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{言|い}い{負|ま}かす: out-argue in a debate

USAGE:
Often has a slightly negative connotation, implying winning through persistence or verbal force rather than logic alone.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{論破|ろんぱ}→論破：17965_ronpa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refute (more formal)
- ⟦{言|い}い{返|かえ}す→言い返す：16418_iikaesu⟧: to talk back
- ⟦{言|い}い{争|あらそ}う→言い争う：14179_iiarasou⟧: to argue, quarrel
